jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
• Location: Paris - Hybrid  

  • Level: C3

  • Team: Client Delivery

  • Salary: Paris €63,900 - €78,100

  • Reporting to: Principal Programme Manager

This role is based in Paris and requires existing right to work in the EU. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As the Technical Project Manager (Platform & Integration), you are the critical link between our core engineering capabilities and our major energy clients. You don't just manage tasks; you orchestrate the journey from internal platform stability to successful client deployment.

Your mission is to ensure that our Environment, Infrastructure, Security and DataMart roadmap is perfectly synchronized with client integration needs. You will act as the single point of accountability, translating complex platform architecture into seamless client implementations, ensuring that what we build internally delivers maximum value and reliability to the external market.

Responsibilities

  • Client Integration & Technical Governance (External Focus)

    • Technical Consulting: Serve as a primary technical contact during client integration projects, translating internal platform architecture and dependencies into clear, actionable requirements for the client's technical teams.

    • Environment Alignment: Own the technical coordination for critical implementation elements across - infrastructure, access, services, APIs, Applications, and DataMart ensuring setup/configuration of client testing and production environments.

    • Security Assurance & Data Protection: Work with clients and Kaluza SMEs to ensure the kaluza platform meets minimum security and data protection requirements. Manage the definition of needs, implementation approach, validation and auditing activities. 

    • Technical Risk Communication: Proactively communicate technical risks, constraints, and trade-offs inherent in the implementation process to client stakeholders and internal commercial teams.

  • Core Platform & Infrastructure Delivery (Internal Focus)

    • Infrastructure Roadmap: Manage internal projects focused on the enhancement and stability of our Technical Infrastructure (Cloud environments, containerization, security tooling) and Tech Operations maturity.

    • Engineering Alignment: Collaborate with Platform Architects, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams to define project scope, secure resources, and manage technical dependencies.

    • Reliability & Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and data projects adhere to security protocols, regulatory requirements, and internal reliability targets.


  • Delivery Methodologies & Reporting

    • Agile Proficiency: Apply expert knowledge of Scrum and Kanban within an engineering context, managing sprint planning, backlog refinement, and continuous delivery practices.

    • System Integration: Also apply your organisational and management skills to large scale, fixed time system integration programs in a way that promotes transparency and minimises delivery risk.

    • Reporting: Provide transparent, data-driven reporting using Jira dashboards and quantifiable metrics, clearly showing the status of both internal delivery and external client dependencies.

    • Blocker Resolution: Facilitate technical and architectural decisions, acting as the primary point of contact to resolve critical technical roadblocks for both internal and client teams.

    • Team / Relationship Management: Form strong working relationships with clients and internal teams. Effectively operate in a matrix team structure. Lead and facilitate meetings and ceremonies.

About You 

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Circa 5 years: of experience as a Technical Project/Program Manager, specifically in roles that required simultaneous management of internal platform engineering and B2B client integrations.

  • Hands-on exposure: to the technicalities of, environment provisioning, security and data projects.

  • Proven track record of navigating the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within a high-growth SaaS, FinTech, or EnergyTech environment.

What will set you apart 

  • Business level French language skills

  • Experience in the Energy or Utility sector is highly advantageous, particularly regarding industry-specific data standards.

  • A ‘can do’ attitude, that is able to create high-performing teams.

Kaluza Values
Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. 

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Adaptfy is growing! We are looking for a Project Management Associate with 5+ years of experience, to join our Data and Analytics team in Amsterdam.


Who we are

Adaptfy is a turnkey data & analytics solution for the SHV family of companies. We support multiple SHV Groups with advanced Data & Analytics in all areas, elevating their operations in diverse industries across international markets and throughout entire value chains.

Adaptfy is a joint venture formed by SHV and Metyis. Metyis embodies visionary thinking in the digital world, while SHV is a globally established family of companies built on the values of integrity, trust, curiosity, passion, and inclusivity.

 SHV has a presence across four continents, with businesses spanning energy, heavy lifting and transport, animal nutrition & aquaculture, testing, inspection & certification, and more. The organisation’s history reflects its courage to care—for people, for performance, and for future generations. Their success is a testament to constant reinvention through innovation.

 At Adaptfy, we play a pivotal role in bringing SHV’s digital vision to life. From optimising supply chains across Europe to enhancing operational efficiency in South America, we connect the dots for SHV, shaping a data-driven future for the entire family of companies.

What we offer

  • Opportunity to accelerate digital growth and business transformation through AI, Data & Analytics, Digital Commerce, advanced technologies, and strategic business solutions.

  • Driving high-impact insights & enhancing decision making across the organization.

  • Driving brand equity and digital sales through enhanced digital experiences.

  • Interaction with senior business (and/or ecommerce) leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.

  • Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team

     

What you will do

  • Support the successful delivery of client engagements across Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, and Business Transformation initiatives.

  • Manage assigned workstreams or smaller projects, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality, and budget.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), status reports, and project documentation.

  • Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks and dependencies, and proactively escalate issues where required.

  • Coordinate project activities across multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective execution and delivery.

  • Build strong working relationships with client stakeholders, project teams, and internal delivery functions.

  • Support governance activities including project reporting, steering committee preparation, action tracking, and decision management.

  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, sprint ceremonies, and status reviews.

  • Ensure clear communication of project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support change management and business readiness activities throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Business Technology consultants, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineers, Designers, and client stakeholders to coordinate successful delivery.

  • Contribute to Agile delivery by supporting sprint planning, backlog reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and dependency management.

  • Ensure project deliverables comply with agreed governance, quality standards, and delivery methodologies.

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, project governance, and team collaboration.

  • Support proposal development, project planning activities, and internal capability initiatives where required.

  • Travel as required to support client engagements.

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Delivery Management, Consulting, Digital Transformation, Technology Delivery, or related roles.

  • Experience supporting or managing projects within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business and technology functions.

  • Good understanding of Project Management principles including planning, governance, scheduling, RAID management, dependency management, budgeting, and reporting.

  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, delivery dashboards, and governance artefacts.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

  • Understanding of project lifecycle management from initiation through delivery and project closure.

  • Understanding of Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Technology initiatives.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Good analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working collaboratively within cross-functional consulting and delivery teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare project reports and executive-ready updates.

  • Experience facilitating project meetings, workshops, and delivery governance sessions.

  • Comfortable working with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and client leadership.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • Willingness to travel based on client and project requirements.

  • Experience delivering Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, Digital Commerce, Data & AI, Cloud, ERP, CRM, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Platform programmes.

  • Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

  • Experience using project delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Confluence, Planner, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or similar collaboration platforms.

  • Foundation certifications in Project Management (PRINCE2 Foundation, PMP, CAPM), Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Change Management.

  • Awareness of PMO governance, financial tracking, resource planning, and portfolio reporting.

  • Knowledge of Dutch or additional European languages is advantageous depending on client engagements.

We are united by our differences

At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

jobs.title: (Associate) Product Manager - Customer Lifecycle (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As an Associate Product Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, you will support the engine which makes sure our already onboarded customers have a positive experience on lifecycle events like re-KYC, account termination and customer service. Furthermore, you will be responsible for making sure lemon.markets delivers on its ongoing regulatory commitments. Your remit also covers owning the tooling which our operations colleagues use every day and making sure these evolve in sync with evolving regulatory landscape as well as business growth.

Reporting to the domain's Senior PM, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work cross-functionally at lemon.markets and regularly interface with stakeholders from varying functional backgrounds. To be successful in this role, you should be able to bring stakeholders on the same page and drive a coherent product strategy aimed at improving the efficiency of processes which kick-in during the lifecycle of a customer with lemon.markets while making sure lemon.markets adheres to its regulatory obligations.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for the problem space end-to-end - i.e. from problem framing through to release, adoption and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional team including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, and your colleagues in functions such as finance, risk and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off tactical fixes.

  • Interface regularly with your immediate customers and stakeholders to understand their pain points, capture feedback and use this information to shape your roadmap and product strategy.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in your problem space, and bring the insights back to the team and introduce informed iterations of your product strategy.

  • Write clearly and often - decision records, partner-facing specs, internal narratives. Writing is how decisions get made here.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 1-2 years of product experience, including independently shipping complex products. You take ownership of outcomes, not just features.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can define an unclear problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You are comfortable working through legal text. You form your own preliminary view on a legal or regulatory question before discussing it with experts, and you know which questions to bring to them.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and you iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You write clearly. Decisions, specs, and partner communication are a core part of this job, and you can make complex topics easy to follow on paper.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and actively explore how far they can take your output.

  • You are professionally fluent in English. However, German speakers would be preferred.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Production Data Storage (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the DODO team in the Platform domain.

Your mission will be to build and maintain the common building blocks of Doctolib's system with a "Platform as a Product" mindset, abstracting and simplifying complex, critical data infrastructure so that product teams can focus on what matters: building faster, better products for healthcare professionals and patients. You will work closely with 600+ engineers across 70+ teams, owning the vision and strategy for data management products that form the foundation of everything we build.

Working in the product team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We operate in feature teams within an agile environment, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own and align the 2-year vision for data storage at Doctolib, defining which datastore products we build, which we source off the shelf, and how they serve both the monolith and the growing ecosystem of services around it

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for data management products used by 600+ engineers, spanning multiple datastores (PostgreSQL/Aurora, Kafka, Debezium, Couchbase), file storage, data access, and data lifecycle solutions

  • Drive reliability, recoverability, and cost transparency across teams, including SLOs, alert ownership, backup and restore testing, and per-team cost visibility

  • Define the experience for managing production data for services outside the monolith and for new AI product storage needs

  • Partner with Staff and Senior Staff Engineers to assess the impact of complex architectural decisions, facilitate consensus across diverse viewpoints, and align stakeholders on contested trade-offs

  • Measure and improve engineer satisfaction with data management products, leading projects end-to-end, from problem definition and specs writing to development validation, rollout, and impact follow-up

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in Product Management with direct product ownership, working with developers, leading rituals, and writing specifications

  • Have extensive experience with technical products and platforms, and a passion for solving complex, large-scale infrastructure challenges

  • Can drive change across large engineering organizations, you're comfortable influencing 600+ engineers across more than 70 teams

  • Have proven experience building and launching products in a large-scale, international B2B environment, where moving fast without slowing down feature development is a constant challenge

  • Are fluent in both English and French (C1 level minimum) and are comfortable working in an international environment

  • Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to transform healthcare

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview (45m) - w Maxime

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60m) - w Loïc 

  • Live-case Interview (90m) 

  • Behavioral Interview (75m)

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Paris, France

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

jobs.description:
About the role:

As Product Manager Mission Aircraft, you will own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our military multi-mission aircraft. The aircraft is designed as an optionally piloted platform combining manned and unmanned operations with modular mission capabilities for applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, operational requirements, engineering feasibility and commercial viability. In close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing and other stakeholders, you will translate complex mission needs into clear product priorities and an executable roadmap. This end-to-end ownership, from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery and lifecycle development, is consistent with Quantum Systems' current Product Management model

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Mission Aircraft, translating market, customer and operational requirements into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Drive customer and market discovery by engaging with end users, governmental customers, Sales and Solutions teams to understand operational challenges, mission scenarios and capability gaps.

  • Shape the multi-mission capability roadmap across relevant applications such as Counter-UxS, ISR, maritime and border patrol, training and manned-unmanned teaming.

  • Drive payload and mission-system integration such as radar, EO/IR, SIGINT, communications and other mission-specific payloads.

    Lead product trade-off decisions across performance, payload, endurance, platform constraints, cost, risk, certification and time-to-market.

  • Own product readiness and lifecycle decisions, defining acceptance criteria and supporting validation, release readiness, market introduction and continuous product improvement.

  • Create cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Programs, Sales, Product Marketing and external technology partners, clearly communicating priorities, dependencies, risks and roadmap decisions.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of ...

  • You already have at least X years of professional/practical experience in ...

  • Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert.

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • You have a degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

  • You have several years of experience in technical Product Management, Systems Engineering or product development within aerospace, defence, UAS, aviation or another complex hardware-software environment.

  • You have experience taking technically complex products or capabilities from customer need and concept through development, validation and market or operational deployment.

  • You have a strong technical understanding and are comfortable working across aircraft systems, hardware, software, sensors, communications and mission-system integration.

  • You have strong commercial judgement and can balance customer value, operational utility, technical feasibility, cost, schedule and product scalability.

  • Ideally, you have experience with military aviation, UAS, ISR, Counter-UAS, mission systems, payload integration or manned-unmanned teaming.

  • You are comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and can bring structure and clarity to complex stakeholder discussions.

  • Communicating in English comes naturally to you; German is a plus. Similar current Quantum Systems Product Manager roles require fluent English and treat German as advantageous.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Digital Assets (H/F)
Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

jobs.title: Technical Delivery Analyst
jobs.description:
Technical Delivery Analyst

Remote (UK-based)

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're hiring the first dedicated Technical Delivery Analyst. You will own the delivery of software projects end-to-end — from requirements through to production — working alongside engineers to ensure work lands on time, risks are visible, and stakeholders always know where things stand. As our engineering organisation grows into more specialised teams, you are the person who sits across the space between them — owning the dependencies, coordination, and communication that no single team owns.

This is not an administrative role. You need to understand the technology being built, speak credibly with engineers about architecture and trade-offs, and translate technical reality into clear communication for the business. You are the person who knows what is happening, why it matters, and what might go wrong — and you make sure everyone else knows too.

You will work closely with the Head of Technical Delivery and daily with Engineering, TechOps, and Product, with regular interaction with client-facing teams (Sales, Client Services). The role offers a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership.

What You'll Work On

Delivery Ownership:

  • Own projects from inception to production — responsible for outcomes, not just process

  • Understand technical scope, architecture, and dependencies well enough to anticipate problems before they surface

  • Ensure infrastructure, testing, performance, and operational readiness are considered from the start

  • Know the current state of your projects at all times

Communication:

  • Communicate early and often — bad news delivered early is manageable; bad news delivered late is a crisis

  • Provide honest, accurate status updates — never spin, never hide, never assume someone else will raise it

  • Tailor to the audience — technical detail for engineers, business impact for leadership, actionable clarity for everyone

Technical Engagement:

  • Participate meaningfully in technical discussions — you don't write code, but you understand what is being built and why

  • Engage with engineers on architecture, dependencies, and integration points to accurately assess delivery risk

  • Bridge engineering and business by translating technical constraints into language stakeholders can act on

Risk Management:

  • Identify risks early through genuine understanding of the work, not by reading ticket statuses

  • Escalate with context — what is the risk, what is the impact, what are the options

  • Contribute to post-incident reviews with a delivery lens — impact, learnings, prevention

Continuous Improvement:

  • Look for friction in how work flows and propose practical improvements

  • Experiment with AI tooling to improve delivery efficiency — reporting, analysis, coordination, and communication

  • Maintain delivery tooling as a means to an end, not an end in itself

What We Need

Technical:

  • 2+ years' experience in technical delivery, project management, or software engineering

  • Previously worked as a software developer, or strong hands-on technical experience with software systems

  • Comfortable reading code, reviewing pull requests for context, and understanding technical trade-offs without simplification

  • Knows what "done" looks like in production — tested, deployed, monitored, documented

  • Familiarity with Agile practices and tools (Jira, Confluence) — values principles over ceremony

  • Financial services or trading technology experience is a strong advantage

How you work:

  • You own it. End-to-end responsibility. If it's your project, it's your problem — you don't wait for someone to tell you something is off

  • You communicate clearly. Exceptional written and verbal communication. Concise, precise, and honest under pressure. Confident raising difficult topics early — with engineers, stakeholders, and leadership alike — and you absorb pushback as readily as you give it, redirecting heat toward the outcome rather than taking it personally

  • You build trust. Engineers respect people who understand the work, tell the truth, and follow through — not a title. You are genuinely interested in the people you work with, and over time they bring you problems before those problems reach a ticket

  • You steady the room. When a project is drifting or an incident is live, you lower the temperature rather than raise it — calm, calibrated, and focused on what needs to happen next

  • You think in outcomes. Updating a board is not the same as delivering software. You impose structure where needed without over-engineering process

  • You stay technically curious. You genuinely want to understand how systems work and fit together. You don't simplify away the complexity that matters

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You exercise judgement. You know when to escalate, when to solve, and when to ask for help

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools to amplify our delivery capability — from reporting and analysis to coordination and communication. You should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real delivery problems — owning end-to-end project outcomes on a market-leading trading platform with genuine scale and technical depth

  • Breadth of exposure — work across the full engineering organisation: backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, and TechOps

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Direct mentorship — access to the Head of Technical Delivery for coaching, feedback, and professional development

  • Career progression — a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Senior Leadership Conversation with our CTO

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy [link to be added].

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
jobs.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange (schaal 10) tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar (op basis van een 38-urige werkweek inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

 
De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:
•    je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;
•    13e maand;
•    variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;
•    arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;
•    26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;
•    goede studiekostenregeling;
•    prima pensioenvoorziening;
•    reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;
•    en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.


Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Bijzonderheden

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

  • Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

  • Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

  • Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

  • Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

  • Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long

  • You have worked at millions-of-records scale

  • You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams

  • You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design

  • You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 

  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it

  • You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it

  • You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti) 

  • Case Study with Product Panel

  • Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Levallois-Perret, France

  • Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
Report to: CEO

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

• (Really) flexible working hours, with a hybrid setup around our Delft office.

• Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with technology that matters.

• Real ownership, fast iteration, and tight feedback loops, and the chance to see what you build deployed in environments where it genuinely counts.

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, LinkedIn, or other source, as long as we get a clear picture of your background and track record.

• We'll get back to you as soon as possible. If we see a potential fit, we'll set up an initial conversation, followed by deeper sessions with the founders and the team where we work through real product scenarios together.

• If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

• Welcome to the team!

Location: Bristol or London

Level: TL1

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Shira Tsinovich

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do


As the QA Lead across Data you will work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms.

You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments.

This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence.

  • Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients.

  • Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams.

  • Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones.

  • Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues.

  • Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD.

  • Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication.

  • Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards.

  • Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early.

  • Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness).

What you’ll bring

  • Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications.

  • Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations.

  • Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues.

  • Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement.

  • Influence and coaching: Ability to influence and negotiate across engineering, product and leadership, hold a firm line on quality standards, and coach engineers and product managers to own the quality of their products.

  • Client Delivery: experience working directly with client teams to define and report quality metrics, and to introduce quality improvement plans.

  • Nice to have: Test automation framework experience; defining quality gates in CI/CD or release pipelines; AI tools for identifying and fixing data issues; data testing and observability tooling; familiarity with data governance, data contracts and GDPR; and Python and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker).

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.
