About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

How do you deliver an AI platform capability that spans multiple engineering teams and an enterprise customer’s go-live date - without compromising quality, reliability or security?

This is the challenge you’ll solve as a Senior Technical Program Manager at Parloa. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead one of Parloa’s most strategic cross-organizational programs from definition through launch.

Parloa is building an enterprise AI platform powering Fortune 2000 companies with conversational AI. Our Agent Management Platform (AMP) is trusted by global organizations including Booking.com, Allianz and American Express. As we scale rapidly, we’re building an engineering organization optimized for speed, quality and innovation.

This role is about delivering outcomes, not coordinating activity.

You will be accountable for one of the company’s highest-impact programs, bringing together multiple engineering teams and cross-functional partners to deliver a critical business outcome. You will own the integrated execution plan, dependency management, launch readiness, executive communication and decision-making mechanisms that determine whether the program succeeds.

When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.

This is not a delivery coordination or Scrum facilitation role. Product defines what we build. Engineering owns how we build it. You ensure we successfully deliver across organizational boundaries.

Enterprise customers expect reliability, security and operational excellence - not just feature delivery. You will establish a clear readiness bar for your program, ensure delivery trade-offs are explicit and well understood, and help leaders make informed decisions before deadlines force implicit ones.

Although you won’t write production code, this is a highly technical role. You should be comfortable discussing architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies, and reliability risks with senior engineers, and be able to challenge assumptions when delivery plans don’t align with technical complexity.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and has successfully delivered complex technical programs across teams they did not directly manage. You are an exceptional written communicator who can simplify ambiguity for executives while earning credibility with engineers. Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.

 

Areas of ownership:

  • Serve as the accountable leader for one strategic cross-organizational program, or two closely related programs, with clear business impact.

  • Build and maintain the integrated execution plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies and cross-team commitments.

  • Drive end-to-end risk management by identifying leading indicators, removing blockers, tracking mitigations and escalating only when executive decisions are required.

  • Define and continuously raise the quality bar for your program by establishing objective launch criteria across functionality, reliability, security and operational readiness.

  • Lead release readiness across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Legal and Commercial teams, ensuring launches are based on measurable readiness rather than feature completion alone.

  • Make delivery trade-offs explicit. Where timelines require compromises, ensure decisions are documented, owned by the appropriate stakeholders and supported by clear mitigation plans.

  • Drive executive decision-making through concise written narratives, data and clear recommendations, replacing fragmented status reporting with a trusted source of truth.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics that enable objective decisions around scope, schedule, quality and execution risk.

  • Build lightweight mechanisms that improve planning, dependency management and execution across teams, leaving the organization stronger after the program completes.

  • Influence technical and organizational decisions without direct authority, aligning engineering, product and business stakeholders around shared outcomes.

Who you are:

  • 7+ years of Technical Program Management experience, or equivalent experience leading large-scale technical programs with software engineering teams.

  • Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs from definition through launch across organizations you did not directly manage.

  • Experience leading release readiness for production systems, including defining objective launch criteria and driving launch decisions.

  • Strong track record of identifying delivery risk early, driving mitigation plans and making effective escalation decisions.

  • Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies and engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience defining program metrics and using data to guide execution and executive decision-making.

  • Exceptional written communication skills. You can distill a complex technical situation into a clear one-page narrative for senior leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience delivering AI, machine learning or LLM-powered products at scale, ideally in a high-growth engineering organization.

  • Experience building program management mechanisms that became durable organizational practices.

How you work:

  • You make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, balancing imperfect information with the need to keep the organization moving.

  • You learn quickly. You have successfully developed deep expertise in unfamiliar technical domains and enjoy mastering new technologies.

  • You move quickly without lowering standards, making pragmatic decisions while ensuring quality, reliability and security remain deliberate choices rather than accidental outcomes.

  • You challenge assumptions with evidence, communicate difficult messages constructively and fully support decisions once they are made.

  • You introduce only the amount of process necessary. Your mechanisms reduce organizational friction rather than create it.

Our recruiting process:

Recruiter Call → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview → Writing Assignment + Leadership Round → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity
 
We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! 
Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment:
 
Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product).
 
Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability.
 
Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives.
 
The team
As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback.
 
Explore Our Tech Blog:
If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!
 
Who you are
 
We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. 
 
Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds.
 
Experience as a software engineer is a plus but not required. The position does not involve coding. You should be able to read and understand code and read / comment / challenge a technical design.
 
To help you better understand the role, here are the qualities we are looking for in an EPM:
Resourcefulness: you like to be dropped in a new context and come up with your own solutions 
Change management: you are a people person and you convey change smartly and courageously
Diligence: you are curious and connect the dots in ways no one else can, you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clarity, and direction
Integrity: you lead by example, inspire others, and always play “first team”
 
The position doesn’t involve people management.
Fluency in English (French not required)

jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 

Your opportunity:

AI is shifting how the best products get built. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread.

At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders.

A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions.

Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized.

Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. If building the thing sounds more natural to you than describing it, this role is for you.

 

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped product. Write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, and get it in front of users, with as few handoffs as possible. Own the full loop.

  • Compress research, synthesis, and spec-writing from weeks into hours. You reach for AI tools not because you’ve been asked to, but because they faster make you faster in delivering high quality outcome. You know when to trust the output, when to edit it, and when to reject it. Use AI as a force multiplier.

  • You structure fuzzy problems, identify what should and shouldn’t be built, and move forward when there are dozens of possible directions. The magic is in the trade-offs, not the feature list. Turn ambiguous ideas into things users can trust.

  • You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-related product work, translating AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, and outputs into clear product decisions. You work effectively in hybrid human-AI teams. Work in small, focused teams.

  • You know the metric your team is trying to move. You measure your week by what changed in user behaviour, not by how many tickets moved to Done. Be accountable to outcomes, not roadmaps.

  • You give feedback directly, to anyone, regardless of level. You raise blockers early and in the open. Push back when something’s wrong. Team player who raises the bar.

 

Your profile:

Your craft

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management (ideally in fintech or B2B). You’ve shipped things that real people use, and you can point to the metric that moved when you did.

  • Understand implicitly the product development process - from discovery, to user research to experimentation. You are able to build and defend a compelling strategy that solves user needs.

  • You have a builder track record: you’ve made things with AI, not just written specs about them. Shipped products, agent workflows, or tools real users have touched. Any of these count whether at work or in your personal life.

  • You’re AI-native by default. You use tools like Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or similar regularly. You follow the AI product space closely and you know the difference between a demo and something production-ready.

  • You’ve built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster. You know when to trust AI output, when to edit it, and when to reject it.

  • You’ve gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief to be written for you. The output was good enough that a team shipped from it.

  • Low PM baggage: you’re not attached to how product management "should" be done. You care about outcomes, not territory.

  • When designing and shipping AI-enabled products, you consider privacy, safety, fairness, transparency, bias, and accountability. You assess when AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use and raise concerns when risks or limitations are identified.

Your range

  • Across all three disciplines, you can hold your own: in Product you can identify opportunities, assess impact, and prioritize ruthlessly. In Design, you have taste: you know when something looks right but feels wrong. Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on!

Your role

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust. 

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems.

jobs.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

Valuable Experience 

  • Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications.

  • Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment.

  • Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI.

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

Founding Product Engineer
London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available

The Mission

We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software.

The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis.

We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own.

Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer.

The Challenge

As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will:

  • Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for.

  • Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it.

  • Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence.

  • Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap.

  • Pioneer the Agentic SDLC: Agents write most of our code. Design the systems, steer the agents, and push our own way of building software forward with a very large token budget.

You Are a Fit If:

  • You are a Product Builder: You might be a product engineer at a SaaS company, a product manager who now ships code, or a consultant building serious AI tooling on the side. We judge purely on the quality of what you have built. You don’t need a 20-page PRD. You can take a vague user pain point from a client and ship a functional prototype by Friday.

  • You value Speed: You believe that in an early-stage startup, iteration velocity is the only unfair advantage. You prefer shipping a 90% solution today over a perfect one next month.

  • You are “T-Shaped”: You hold deep experience in one area (product management, management consulting, or front-end engineering), but are comfortable enough with the others to add value across the business.

Our Stack

  • Product: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind

  • Data and Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Terraform

  • Real-time: Collaboration over WebSockets

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership: £120K to £200K base salary plus equity. You will own a piece of the company you are building, and you will own the product roadmap with the CTO.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

What you will do

Find the problems that matter

  • Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

  • See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

  • Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

Build with AI, in your work and in our product

  • Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

  • Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

  • Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

Deliver with rigour

  • Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

  • Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

  • Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

  • Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

  • Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

  • Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

  • Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B platforms is helpful but not essential

  • You're excited about changing how people buy and sell cars

Benefits

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:

  • Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office, with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

  • Great work-life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

jobs.description:
The opportunity

Founded in 2013, Doctolib is Europe's leading AI and digital health company, serving 580,000 health professionals and 100 million people. We are building a new way to build software: agents doing the grunt work of writing, testing, reviewing and merging code, with engineers moving into a control-tower role to monitor and intervene.

Your mission: build the tooling and workflows that let AI agents and the engineers who work alongside them  test, review, ship and monitor code reliably, so Doctolib can multiply its engineering output while keeping quality and control.

The role

We're looking for a Director of AI Developer Experience to lead our new AI Developer Experience team, reporting to the VP Platform Engineering. You will also own the existing CI and Developer Experience scope.

Doctolib is moving AI adoption from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent capability. The current team includes two Product Managers and two engineers, with more people joining through internal transfers and hiring.

Your team will own:

  • The agent-native testing and feedback infrastructure that lets agents know, within their own workflow, whether what they built is correct.

  • CI/CD and build systems for the monolith and satellite services, elevated from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.

  • Developer productivity measurement in the AI era DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators.

  • The inner-loop experience: local and remote environments, onboarding, editor integration and sandboxing.

Your impact

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build the tools and workflows that allow agents to write, test, review and merge code, including evaluation, security checks and controls giving agents a fast, reliable feedback loop on whether what they build is correct.

  • Own testing and feedback for the monolith and satellite services, elevating the current CI setup from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.

  • Own developer productivity measurement in the context of AI DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators  and make it visible and actionable to feature teams.

  • Lead the inner-loop experience: local and remote environments, onboarding, editor integration and sandboxing.

  • Build and organise the team, developing agentic skills internally where needed, as AI adoption shifts from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent one.

  • Partner with Product Engineering and Product Management to understand internal users and drive adoption.

Your team

Reporting to the VP Platform Engineering, Mike Aidane, you'll join the Platform Engineering leadership team alongside directors and senior EMs for Application Platform, Data Services and Platform Services.

You will lead the new AI Developer Experience team, which includes Automation Platform (CI team), ILOT (Internal LLMs Ops & Training team) and TestingOps.

You'll partner closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, Release Engineering, Quality Engineering, Infrastructure Platform, SRE, FinOps, Security, Privacy and Compliance, and engineering teams across France and Germany.

Your profile

You have led engineering organisations through large-scale Developer Experience transformations and know what it takes to ship great tooling fast, durably, and without sacrificing quality. You think in systems technical and organisational and are as comfortable setting architecture direction as you are making a hard technical call.

Core qualifications:

  • You have led Developer Experience, Developer Productivity, Developer Infrastructure or Build/CI organisations serving 300+ engineers. You have demonstrated measurable change in how engineers work, with evidence of adoption, productivity outcomes and organisational or operating-model change.

  • You have deep technical credibility across CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, monorepo build graphs, test selection, caching, merge queues and flake management. You can guide architecture and trade-offs while remaining credible with Staff Engineers and strong EMs.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a manager of managers: hiring, growing and levelling engineering managers and staff-plus ICs.

  • You are comfortable setting your own success metrics and being held to them, with strong written communication and structured thinking.

  • You are fluent in English.

Bonus points for:

  • Recent exposure to AI-assisted or agentic engineering transformation, including evaluation, security, guardrails, adoption and productivity measurement. Several years of AI Developer Experience leadership are not expected — the relevant signal is strong large-scale DevEx experience combined with recent AI transformation exposure.

  • Experience with large legacy codebases or monoliths, or in a regulated or high-trust environment such as healthcare. You treat constraints as design inputs, not blockers.

  • Having led multi-country, distributed engineering organisations.

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Intro with the VP Platform Engineering

  • Deep dive on your large-scale Developer Experience transformation

  • Business case presentation

  • Cross-functional panel with Product Engineering and Product Management leaders

  • Executive conversation

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Geef richting aan de toekomst van high-tech elektronica.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële systemen tot geavanceerde semicon-oplossingen: onze Electrical Engineers staan aan de basis van technologie die wereldwijd wordt toegepast. Ben jij de leider die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, kennis en technische excellence? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

 

Als Electrical Engineering Manager beweeg jij je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt je je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar ook op de technische uitdagingen van morgen. Je stimuleert kennisontwikkeling, versterkt engineering excellence en helpt richting te geven aan de verdere groei van Electrical Engineering binnen Benchmark.

 

Je geeft leiding aan een team van circa 40 engineers en speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste technische disciplines binnen Benchmark. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, groei en prestaties van de organisatie en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers kunnen excelleren, innoveren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

 

Met jouw visie op leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en technologie bouw je aan een sterke engineeringcultuur waarin vakmanschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze Electrical Engineering-organisatie klaar blijft voor de complexe technologische vraagstukken van onze klanten én de ambities van de toekomst.

 

Jij combineert technisch leiderschap, people management en strategische ontwikkeling. Daarom ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van circa 40 Electrical Engineers.

  • Het leiden van de AI-transformatie binnen Electrical Engineering.

  • Het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie op Electrical Engineering en het vertalen hiervan naar de praktijk.

  • Het stimuleren van innovatie, kennisontwikkeling en technische excellentie binnen het vakgebied.

  • Het ontwikkelen van competenties, groeipaden en vakmanschap binnen jouw team.

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit, capaciteit en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Het ondersteunen en adviseren van Program Managers bij complexe ontwikkelprojecten.

  • Het aantrekken, selecteren en ontwikkelen van technisch talent.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking met internationale engineering teams binnen Benchmark.

  • Het bijdragen aan organisatie brede besluitvorming als onderdeel van het Competence Management Team en aan een lerende organisatie waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan.

 

Samen met de managers van Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de totale engineeringorganisatie. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines, waaronder HR. Omdat het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van talent in deze schaarse arbeidsmarkt essentieel is, beschik je over een sterk professioneel netwerk en weet je talent aan je team en organisatie te verbinden.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

 

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

 

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

 

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

jobs.title: Software Lead Engineer | NTS Eindhoven
jobs.description:
At NTS, we make it possible together. Technology inspires and drives us; it is our passion. Every day we work on unique solutions to complex challenges. Whether it's ultra-complex or ultra-precise solutions, we are proud of what we do and what we deliver.

Want to set the technical direction of complex software projects and guide engineering teams towards reliable, high-quality solutions? Are you passionate about software development and high-tech product development, and do you enjoy combining technical expertise with technical leadership? Then get started as Software Lead Engineer at NTS Eindhoven and let's make it possible together.

Job Description

As Software Lead Engineer/ Technical Lead at NTS Eindhoven, you set the technical direction for our software projects and coordinate the technical work of the engineers assigned to them. Working in collaborative teams of fewer than ten colleagues, you translate project objectives and complex requirements into software architecture, design decisions and executable technical plans.

This is a technical leadership role without line-management responsibility. You lead through technical direction, coordination and coaching, while the Group Lead or Competence Manager remains responsible for people management.

Our teams develop qualification tools, semiconductor equipment, defence and healthcare systems, and other advanced technology solutions. You collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers to deliver integrated system solutions that meet high quality standards.

We value clear and transparent communication. You proactively identify technical risks and roadblocks, support the team in resolving challenges and ensure that solutions are delivered in line with project objectives.

Furthermore, your key responsibilities are:

  • Lead the technical side of software projects, including architecture, design and technical decision-making;

  • Coordinate the technical work of engineers allocated to your projects and ensure alignment with project plans;

  • Provide accurate technical estimates and planning input to project managers;

  • Safeguard software quality by promoting best practices, code reviews and effective test strategies;

  • Identify technical risks and roadblocks early and define and implement mitigation actions;

  • Coach and support colleagues technically, encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement;

  • Stay close to the code and contribute hands-on whenever required.

Job Requirements

To be successful in this role, you bring a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities and interpersonal skills. You recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field;

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in developing technical software using C#, .NET/.NET Framework or C++ (knowledge of C is a plus);

  • Proven experience in setting technical direction, coordinating engineering activities and guiding other software engineers, with or without formal line-management responsibility;

  • Experience in UI development, for example WPF, and a strong understanding of OOP principles and UML design;

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and with Azure DevOps or similar platforms;

  • Experience in a high-tech mechatronic environment is a strong advantage;

  • Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is a plus: databases, DevOps, test strategy, electronics or mechatronics, and computer vision;

  • Excellent communication and social skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in an understandable way;

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus;

  • A proactive team player with a strong willingness to learn, develop and collaborate in the fast-evolving high-tech industry.

Your terms of employment

At NTS, we combine our passion for technology with innovative solutions to complex challenges. You get the freedom and confidence to fully use and develop your talents in a dynamic and energetic environment. We invest both in technology and in you as a future colleague!

With this challenge, we offer the following terms of employment:

  • Competitive salary;

  • A position at NTS Eindhoven, with a working week of at least 32 hours;

  • Personal growth and development opportunities, for example through training and/or education;

  • 27 vacation days and an additional 13 ADV days;

  • Excellent pension plan with PME;

  • Travel expense allowance paid monthly, with a maximum of 50 km per single journey and an allowance of €0.21 per km;

About NTS

We deliver unique solutions to complex challenges and drive technological advancement for our customers. By combining development, manufacturing and assembly, we play an integral role in bringing the supply chain together. We combine the best skills and brightest ideas into a working system for the world's most advanced Semiconductor, Opto-Mechatronics and Analytical solutions. For this reason, we have grown into a Tier-1 supplier to OEMs and an international player operating from various (production) sites in Europe, Asia and the US.

Although we offer our teams around the world a great place to work, we do not forget to remain firmly rooted locally. Ultimately, the core of NTS is our people. Their excellent manufacturing skills, customer-focused mindset and clear technical solutions have made NTS what it is today. Together, we create a culture that everyone can be proud of because we make it possible together. That's why we take every opportunity to celebrate our people, our craftsmanship and our successes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - iOS/Swift
jobs.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

Join us as a Senior Product Engineer (iOS/Swift) to build the mobile app that 750,000 customers across Europe use to run their business finances every day, and to keep it fast and reliable as it grows.

Impact: Your work ships to the customers who use Qonto's iOS app for their daily payments and cash management. You will join one of our squads, each owning a clear product scope. You'll work with a team lead, Product, Design, and Frontend and Backend engineers. Squads have 5 to 10 people.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end to end: Take mobile features from technical design to production, on critical architecture and UI work that customers use daily.

  • Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and lead new initiatives in your squad's scope.

  • Raise quality: Keep the codebase healthy through continuous refactoring, unit tests and snapshot tests.

  • Migrate to SwiftUI: Move screens to SwiftUI (MVVM, async/await) as part of the ongoing migration.

  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with back-end teams, designers and product managers so the whole team shares one vision.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • iOS expertise: You have proven experience as a native mobile engineer, with strong Swift skills and a deep understanding of the iOS SDK and development lifecycle. You'll use it daily on a 100% Swift app.

  • Quality-driven development: You're committed to best practices such as unit testing (XCTest, FBSnapshots), clean code and SOLID principles. This matters in a codebase with 30,000+ unit tests.

  • Pragmatic problem solving: You deliver tangible value in a fast-moving context, and you pick the simplest solution that works.

  • Collaboration: You communicate clearly in English and work well with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Curiosity: You enjoy learning new technologies and use AI tools to raise the bar, not only to go faster.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A mature, modern codebase: 100% Swift, MVP and Clean Architecture, 35+ independent modules and a centralized design system. New screens use SwiftUI, and 80+ are already migrated.

  • Solid engineering practices: Upfront technical design, team code reviews, 450+ snapshot tests, and CI/CD on GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, Fastlane and Tuist.

  • Autonomy inside a clear mission: Each project has one team lead and a clear mission, and your squad decides how it works. We use Kaizen and PDCA to improve together, following the Qonto Way.

  • AI in your daily work: Every engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and LLMs are part of our development workflow.

  • A large mobile community: You'll be part of a 140-strong mobile engineering community within a 500-person Product Engineering department. You get mentorship, Tech Weeklies and Monthlies, and conference opportunities. Read about our mobile performance indicators here.

➡️ Your future manager

We hire for several squads and domains, so you'll meet your future team lead during the interview process. They run one clear project mission and hand you full ownership of a product scope. You'll talk to them directly before you decide.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

jobs.title: Product & Operations Management Apprentice
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace, with a team of 650 people powering operations across 18 countries and counting.

Our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech more sustainably by offering a high-quality, accessible and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that is changing the way the world consumes tech.

We are looking for a curious, organized and proactive Product & Business Operations Apprentice to join our Partnerships team.

The Partnerships team works with telecom, retail and other strategic partners to make refurbished technology more accessible to customers. We manage a growing portfolio of partnerships, launch new commercial opportunities and continuously improve the customer journeys and operating processes that support them.

This apprenticeship is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, Business Operations, Partnerships, Analytics and Commercial Operations. You will help the team scale its operating model by taking ownership of structured recurring activities, supporting launches and experiments, and identifying opportunities to improve our processes.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Monitor partnership health by updating dashboards, reviewing customer journeys, tracking incidents and preparing portfolio summaries.

  • Contribute to new partnership features and drive continuous improvement by managing product partnership initiatives, documenting requirements, coordinating delivery and contributing to experiments.

  • Coordinate launch and QA activities, including test plans and launch-readiness updates.

  • Support business operations through reporting, basic analysis, meeting follow-ups, documentation and invoicing reconciliation.

  • Be an active part in onboarding new partners to Back Market.

  • Contribute to new partnership projects by researching potential partners, preparing benchmarks and helping improve or automate recurring processes.

TOOLS YOU’LL USE: ⚒️

Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Google Slides, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, and internal Back Market tools.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are enrolled in a French higher-education programme that includes an apprenticeship contract.

  • You are looking for a multi-year apprenticeship, ideally in product management, business operations, partnerships, analytics, business, engineering or a related field.

  • You are fluent in both written and spoken French and English, as we are an international team. This is mandatory.

  • You are organized, rigorous and comfortable managing several topics at the same time.

  • You enjoy working with data, spreadsheets and recurring reports, and can identify trends or discrepancies.

  • You take ownership, ask good questions and follow through on commitments.

  • You are a clear and structured communicator who enjoys coordinating with different stakeholders.

  • You are curious and comfortable switching between detailed execution and a broader understanding of business objectives.

  • You are interested in product, partnerships, e-commerce, telecom, marketplaces or business operations.

  • You enjoy improving processes rather than simply repeating them.

  • You are comfortable learning new tools and working in an evolving environment.

  • You have a strong team spirit and enjoy collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations and customer-facing teams.

Bonus points if:

  • You have previous experience in product management, business operations, project management, partnerships or analytics.

  • You have worked with dashboards, QA processes, experiments or reporting workflows.

  • You have used automation or no-code tools.

  • You have experience in e-commerce, telecom, retail or marketplace environments.

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • HR Interview with Campus Recruitment Manager

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your motivation, organization and analytical approach.

  • Team/Cultural fit interview with with stakeholders from tech and data.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.
