jobs.title: Head of Product Experience
jobs.description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of travelers find and book the right stay at the right price. They can book with us directly, compare offers across 100+ booking sites, or book through partners who offer our experience under their own brand.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

🔍 Who we're looking for

We're looking for a senior design leader to own Vio's whole user experience: Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and the product outcomes they serve. You'll lead a team of around ten across design, research and content. This is a chance to build a function, not inherit one.

You'll report to our Head of Product and sit in domain leadership alongside product, engineering and commercial leaders, shaping strategy from the start. Vio runs two businesses on one platform: our consumer product, and white-label and API products for partners. Your job is to make the experience across both recognisably world-class, and to build a team that can sustain it.

☑️ What you'll do

  • Set the UX vision for Vio's next chapter, and bring product, engineering and commercial partners along with it.

  • Own user-facing outcomes with your peers, and make design's contribution measurable.

  • Lead Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and design the org that brings them together in your first 90 days.

  • Set and hold the craft bar: run critique and product reviews, and make journeys consistent across our products and brands.

  • Work with Product and Engineering on how we ship, not only what we ship: bring design into problem framing early, and raise the quality of what reaches our users.

  • Build a team people want to join and stay in: clear ownership, air cover, real growth paths, and recognition for great work.

  • Stay close to the work, with ring-fenced time on north-star concepts and cross-product journeys.

  • Make AI part of how design, research and content work.

  • Give design a stronger voice inside Vio and a visible presence outside it.

🔎 Who you are

  • You've led a multi-discipline UX organisation (design and design systems, research, content) at scale, including leaders of leaders, with real depth across all three, including research.

  • You frame the problem before the solution, make trade-offs between user and commercial needs, and can show the outcomes and metrics you've moved with Product.

  • You're a credible peer to senior product, engineering and business leaders, and you influence beyond design.

  • You've designed B2B2C products, where partners offer the product to their own customers and judge it as well as end users.

  • Your own craft holds up at the highest level: you lead critique, set the quality bar in the details, and articulate a vision that others rally behind.

  • You build teams that grow, and you hire people stronger than yourself.

  • You use AI in your own practice and know how to scale it across a team.

Nice to have: travel, marketplace or OTA experience; multi-brand or white-label design systems; a visible external profile through talks, writing or case studies.

❓ Why join us now?

DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

  • Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.

  • Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store).

  • Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues.

  • Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments.

  • Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance.

  • Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

  • Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve.

  • Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations.

  • Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction.


Essential skills

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

  • Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.).

  • Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS

  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

  • Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration.

  • Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Desirable skills

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech.

  • Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments.

  • Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS).

  • Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.


On a typical week

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences.

Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing.

After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks.

We offer

  • A revenue-generating role in a fast-growing scale-up company; 

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a satellite office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work at AIHR

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 4 Trust days per year (ad-hoc recovery days to take whenever you're overwhelmed, exhausted, or need to deal with something personal);

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!


Who you are

We're looking for an ambitious, data-driven, and commercially minded growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit. Someone who loves identifying opportunities, challenging existing approaches, and turning ideas into measurable results. You're not just a strategic thinker; you're equally excited about getting operational, executing ideas yourself, and making things happen.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling customer acquisition, ideally across both B2C and B2B businesses in SaaS, e-learning, or other high-growth industries;

  • Demonstrable experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns, including managing or scaling advertising budgets of €100,000+ per month;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive into performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable initiatives;

  • A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, including paid acquisition, CRO, landing page optimization, email marketing, and growth economics such as CAC and LTV;

  • Strong experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and reporting;

  • Experience identifying, testing, and scaling new acquisition channels and growth opportunities;

  • Strong AI proficiency, with experience using ChatGPT and Claude to analyze data, improve workflows, and accelerate execution;

  • An understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing customer acquisition, with a forward-thinking approach to emerging marketing channels;

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to independently lead and execute initiatives while collaborating effectively with the wider team;

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a hunger to grow;

  • Bonus: Experience in event marketing, community-led growth, or account-based marketing (ABM).

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our new Senior Growth Marketing Manager? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

Ton rôle chez Dastra

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.

  • Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client.

  • Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects.

  • Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients.

Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique, idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes, avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

jobs.title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
jobs.description:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers

  • Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps

  • Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team

  • Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations

  • Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums

  • Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

  • Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

  • GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

  • Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

  • Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Achieving this ambitious goal requires more than innovative engineering — it requires a supply chain capable of turning complex technologies into reliable, manufacturable solutions.

As a Supply Chain Engineer, you'll serve as the critical technical link between our Engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring components, materials, and systems can be sourced, manufactured, and delivered to meet our development needs. You'll own technical sourcing assessments and supplier readiness across one or two assigned technology domains, such as Laser, Targetry, Chamber, or Core Engineering.

Working closely with Engineering, Strategic Procurement, and Quality Management, you'll bring supplier capabilities and manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying technical challenges, assessing manufacturability, and addressing supply risks before they become costly delays. This is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise in a highly collaborative, fast-moving environment where your technical judgment directly influences project readiness and our ability to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Technical Sourcing Readiness: Lead technical feasibility and sourcing-readiness assessments across your assigned technology domain, evaluating supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, and technical requirements from early development through sourcing readiness.

  • Connect Engineering with Suppliers: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for suppliers within your domain, partnering with Engineering and Strategic Procurement to identify, assess, and engage potential suppliers.

  • Drive Early Supplier Involvement: Bring supplier manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying manufacturability challenges and opportunities before designs are finalized.

  • Translate Engineering Requirements: Work with Engineering to clarify incomplete or ambiguous specifications, drawings, and technical requirements to ensure they are accurate and ready for sourcing.

  • Develop Supplier Readiness: Build and track technical supplier development and qualification plans in partnership with Supplier Quality, ensuring suppliers have the capabilities and readiness needed to support development milestones.

  • Improve Manufacturability and Cost: Collaborate with Engineering and suppliers to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity, optimize costs, and minimize lead times.

  • Inform Supplier Selection: Provide technical assessments, supplier capability insights, and recommendations to support Strategic Procurement's supplier evaluation and award decisions.

  • Manage Technical Supply Risks: Identify and proactively escalate supplier capacity constraints, long lead times, technical dependencies, and other risks that could impact project timelines.

  • Enable Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain clear technical documentation, supplier readiness information, and risk assessments to support effective handovers between Engineering, Procurement, and Quality.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, manufacturing engineering, or a related role within a complex technical or industrial environment.

  • You have a strong understanding of relevant manufacturing technologies, materials, processes, and supplier capabilities within your area of expertise.

  • You can evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, and manufacturing requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential manufacturability challenges.

  • You have experience assessing supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and readiness, ideally within highly engineered products, advanced manufacturing, or complex system development.

  • You understand how to balance technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, and lead-time considerations to support effective sourcing decisions.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and exercising independent technical judgment, knowing when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate decisions requiring Engineering, Quality, or commercial approval.

  • You are a proactive communicator who can translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with engineers, suppliers, procurement professionals, and quality teams.

  • You demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through, taking responsibility for technical sourcing readiness within your domain and ensuring risks and open issues are addressed early.

  • You enjoy working in a growing organization where you can help establish processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and contribute to building a scalable supply chain.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

You should apply if you have:

  • Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

  • Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

  • Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.

Technical Skills

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Themen der Hauptbuchhaltung, insbesondere Rückstellungen, personalbezogene Buchungen sowie Kontenabstimmungen.

B. Nebenbücher, Tax, Treasury und Investor Relatons), sowie anderen Stakeholdern zusammen.

Was du mitbringst:

Was wir anbieten:

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
About the role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to be the face of Taktile for our future team members. Your primary responsibilities will include sourcing, recruiting, and managing the candidate journey to ensure we attract and hire exceptional talent. As a key driver of our growth, your work will directly influence the success and scalability of our operations.

This role is perfect for someone eager to play a central role in shaping Taktile's organization. We are looking for a skilled recruiter who knows how to identify and attract top talent and who thrives in the fast-moving, competitive landscape of AI.

This role is based in our London or Berlin office. We believe great recruiting is highly collaborative and relationship-driven, so we work together in person at least three days per week.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full recruiting cycle for a portfolio of GTM roles, from role scoping with hiring managers through offer close, moving fast without sacrificing quality or candidate experience.

  • Build and execute sourcing strategies tailored to each role, using LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-assisted tools, and creative outreach to reach both active and passive candidates.

  • Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, not just an executor. That means shaping job requirements, challenging assumptions, and keeping searches on track when priorities shift.

  • Deliver a standout candidate experience at every touchpoint: clear communication, timely feedback, and a process that reflects Taktile's values even when we're moving quickly.

  • Leverage data to drive decisions. Track pipeline health, identify drop-off points, and share regular hiring funnel updates that lead to action, not just reporting.

  • Act as a strong partner and domain expert to the organization. Collaborate closely with leaders to comprehend their hiring needs and develop recruiting strategies to meet headcount targets. This person will be a senior partner to our leaders and shape our overall talent strategy.

  • Contribute to how we hire, not just who we hire. Help refine our assessment frameworks, improve structured interview practices, and bring new ideas for how Taktile stays competitive in a tight talent market.

  • Support employer branding and talent marketing through events, content, and community presence, making Taktile a name candidates recognize and want to join.

  • Collaborate with People Ops to ensure smooth handoffs post-offer, including onboarding coordination, relocations, and visa support where needed.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in proactive sourcing and talent acquisition, preferably in high-growth startups or dynamic environments.

  • Deep experience hiring across GTM functions- including Account Executives, BDRs, Solutions Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, & Marketing. You know how to read a strong GTM candidate and how to sell a compelling opportunity to them.

  • Experience partnering with leaders throughout the recruiting process, acting as a strong hiring partner and trusted advisor.

  • Actively using AI tools in your recruiting workflow- whether for sourcing, outreach personalization, candidate research, or pipeline management. You stay current with the evolving recruiter tech stack and bring a point of view on how AI can make hiring smarter and faster.

  • Skilled in using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS tools, and Google Suite to streamline the recruitment process for both active and passive candidates.

  • Proficient in sourcing talent across a range of seniority levels, from entry-level graduates to senior professionals.

  • Expertise in conducting behavioral and competency-based interviews with a strong ability to effectively evaluate candidates’ skills, cultural fit, and potential.

  • Experience managing both high-volume hiring and specialized searches for niche roles.

  • Familiarity with tracking and analyzing recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-hire, quality of hire, and source effectiveness) and using data to refine strategies and improve processes.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Experience in B2B SaaS recruitment.

  • Familiarity with Ashby

Our Offer

  • Make a meaningful impact by shaping a fast-growing company and creating new opportunities.

  • We offer a competitive salary for this role along with an equity component as part of the total compensation package. The final compensation, including salary and equity, will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

  • Market-led and competitive benefits package including access to a self-development budget for conferences, books, or classes.

  • Join us onsite in our inspiring office spaces in Berlin, NYC, or London.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy, interacting directly with founding team members and voicing your ideas.

  • Learn from experienced mentors, including the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath.

  • Join us at an early but pivotal growth stage where you can take ownership to help us achieve the right business outcomes. 

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. 

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism, and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify, or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Taktile’s Applicant Privacy Policy. To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: SIPP Administrator (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping and growing Upvest's presence in the UK market. You'll work with industry-leading technology, make a tangible impact as we expand our business, and collaborate closely with our operational teams across London and Berlin. With frequent opportunities to visit our Berlin HQ, you'll build strong relationships, exchange ideas face-to-face and be part of a truly international team.

What you’ll do:

  • Support with designing and implementing key SIPP operational processes, such as processing of tax relief claims, and pension withdrawals, contributing to building a best-in-class product

  • Assist and support designing our E2E pension transfer process whether the transfer is completed manually or with use of Origo software

  • Demonstrate your attention to detail whilst processing Letters of Authorities, payments, payroll and tax relief claims

  • Build relationships with the operational teams of our clients and assist them in supporting their end-users with SIPP related queries

  • Optimise workflows, implementing automation and AI to enhance operational efficiency, all while ensuring regulatory compliance and internal policy adherence to mitigate risks for reliable, secure operations

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Treasury and other teams to support efficient processes and address challenges as they arise

  • Monitor key metrics related to our SIPP, providing insights to support business decisions and improve performance

What you bring:

  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience within pension operations, SIPP transfers and familiarity with Origo transfer software

  • Understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks such as CASS

  • Proven track record of managing teams and driving operational excellence

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills; ability to identify errors

  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

  • Fluent in English - both written and verbal

  • Experience in data analysis and process automation using data visualization tools, SQL, Python, or similar is a plus

It’s great if you are:

  • Looking to progress your career and explore management

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Learning & Adoption Specialist (CDD de 12 mois)

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)

Niveau : senior

Équipe : Client Delivery EMEA

Contrat : CDD de 12 mois

Rattachement : Operating Model Design Lead

À noter : Ce poste nécessite un droit au travail déjà acquis dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions la question poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Merci de postuler en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

  • Être un partenaire de confiance : mener des analyses approfondies des besoins de formation pour comprendre les défis propres à chaque client, partenaire et équipe interne.

  • Concevoir des programmes d’apprentissage sur mesure qui vont au-delà de la formation et produisent des résultats business mesurables.

  • Créer des supports de formation de grande qualité, en français et en anglais : ateliers interactifs, modules d’e-learning et guides de référence rapide.

  • Animer ces sessions à distance et en présentiel, en rendant le complexe simple et en renforçant la confiance de votre audience à chaque échange.

  • Accélérer l’adoption de la plateforme Kaluza grâce à un accompagnement et à du coaching après la formation.

  • Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.


Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

  • Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

  • Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

  • Sens de la simplification : vous savez naturellement traduire des concepts techniques et métier complexes en supports clairs, engageants et pratiques.

  • Talent d’animation : vous êtes un·e intervenant·e dynamique et sûr·e de vous, capable de captiver des publics variés et de créer un cadre d’apprentissage interactif et convivial.

  • Esprit collaboratif et proactif : vous travaillez bien en équipe, vous construisez des relations solides et vous identifiez spontanément des façons d’aider les autres et de progresser en continu.

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une connaissance du secteur de l’énergie : une expérience concrète des opérations d’un fournisseur d’énergie ou des technologies de décarbonation, pour relier la formation aux défis réels de nos clients.

  • Une culture de l’excellence opérationnelle : une connaissance des processus de centre de contact ou des technologies de service client, pour concevoir des formations qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de leadership en formation : un parcours démontré de montée en charge de programmes de formation et une capacité à réfléchir stratégiquement à la construction d’une culture d’apprentissage au sein d’une organisation internationale.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici.
